verses.4: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.

paragraphs: Read through 3 John 1:1-4 and reflect on the questions below.

questions: Scripture: What verse was meaningful to you?
Observation: What is God saying to you in this scripture? Ask the Holy Spirit to teach you and reveal Jesus to you. Paraphrase and write this scripture down in your own words.

Application: Personalize what you have read by asking yourself how it applies to your life right now. Perhaps it is instruction, encouragement, revelation, a new promise or corrections for an area of your life. Write down how this passage applies to you today.

Prayer: This can be as simple as asking God to help you live out the truth from this passage, or it may be seeking God for a greater understanding of what He may be revealing to you. Remember, prayer is a two-way conversation, so be sure to listen to what God has to say!

verses.5: Dear friend, you are faithful in what you are doing for the brothers, even though they are strangers to you.
verses.6: They have told the church about your love. You will do well to send them on their way in a manner worthy of God.
verses.7: It was for the sake of the Name that they went out, receiving no help from the pagans.
verses.8: We ought therefore to show hospitality to such men so that we may work together for the truth.
verses.9: I wrote to the church, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first, will have nothing to do with us.
verses.10: So if I come, I will call attention to what he is doing, gossiping maliciously about us. Not satisfied with that, he refuses to welcome the brothers. He also stops those who want to do so and puts them out of the church.

verses.11: Dear friend, do not imitate what is evil but what is good. Anyone who does what is good is from God. Anyone who does what is evil has not seen God.
verses.12: Demetrius is well spoken of by everyone--and even by the truth itself. We also speak well of him, and you know that our testimony is true.
verses.13: I have much to write you, but I do not want to do so with pen and ink.
verses.14: I hope to see you soon, and we will talk face to face. Peace to you. The friends here send their greetings. Greet the friends there by name.

paragraphs: Read through 3 John 1:11-14 and pray this prayer:

Lord Jesus, we humbly ask that You will remove every ungodly appetite in our lives. We want to continue to bear witness to the truth. Dear Lord, please empower us to be imitators of good things. In the name of Jesus, amen.
